title: Banking and finance
focus: 存款 · 贷款 · 利息 · 投资 · 保险 · 税 · 理财 · 转账
body:
Money once it is in the bank: saving, borrowing, paying tax and moving it around. Sentences recycle the money words from L9 and the paperwork from L18.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| 存款 | cúnkuǎn | savings (money in the bank) | stored sum → savings |
| 贷款 | dàikuǎn | loan / to take out a loan | lent sum → loan |
| 利息 | lìxī | interest (on money) | profit that grows → interest |
| 投资 | tóuzī | to invest / investment | throw money in → invest |
| 保险 | bǎoxiǎn | insurance | protect against risk → insurance |
| 税 | shuì | tax | grain radical: tax paid in grain |
| 理财 | lǐcái | to manage one's money / personal finance | manage wealth → personal finance |
| 转账 | zhuǎnzhàng | to transfer money (bank or app) | turn over to an account |

## Which word?

**存款 vs 存钱:** 存款 is the money sitting in the bank (a noun); 存钱 is the act of putting money away.

**贷款 vs 欠 (L9):** 贷款 is a formal loan from a bank; 欠 is simply owing anyone.

## Sentences

- 现在存款利息太低了，不划算。 xiànzài cúnkuǎn lìxī tài dī le, bú huàsuàn: Interest on savings is so low now, it's not worth it.
- 买房得贷款，压力确实很大。 mǎi fáng děi dàikuǎn, yālì quèshí hěn dà: Buying a flat means taking out a loan, and that's real pressure.
- 我妈怀疑网上那些投资都是骗人的。 wǒ mā huáiyí wǎngshang nàxiē tóuzī dōu shì piàn rén de: My mum suspects all those online investments are scams.
- 我刚转账给你了，你确认一下。 wǒ gāng zhuǎnzhàng gěi nǐ le, nǐ quèrèn yíxià: I've just transferred it to you, can you check it came through?
- 去银行办理贷款，要带很多材料。 qù yínháng bànlǐ dàikuǎn, yào dài hěn duō cáiliào: To get a loan at the bank, you need to bring a lot of documents.
- 扣完税和保险，工资就没剩多少了。 kòu wán shuì hé bǎoxiǎn, gōngzī jiù méi shèng duōshao le: After tax and insurance, there's not much salary left.
- 他太会理财了，难怪存款那么多。 tā tài huì lǐcái le, nánguài cúnkuǎn nàme duō: He's so good with money, no wonder he has so much saved.
- 我羡慕那些会投资理财的人。 wǒ xiànmù nàxiē huì tóuzī lǐcái de rén: I envy people who know how to invest and manage their money.

cards.Example: 我们的存款不多了。 wǒmen de cúnkuǎn bù duō le: We don't have much savings left
cards.Notes: 存 cún store, keep (存钱, 保存) + 款 kuǎn sum of money (付款, 贷款) = stored money, so savings. 存钱 = to save (verb); 存款 = the savings themselves. Mirror: 取款 (取 take) = withdraw cash.

cards.English: loan / to take out a loan
cards.Example: 他们贷款买了辆车。 tāmen dàikuǎn mǎi le liàng chē: They took out a loan to buy a car
cards.Notes: 贷 dài lend, 贝 shell = money, as in 贵, 费, 货 + 款 kuǎn sum of money (存款, 付款) = lent money, so a loan. 贷款 is from a bank; 借钱 is borrowing from people.

cards.Example: 现在银行利息很低。 xiànzài yínháng lìxī hěn dī: Bank interest is really low right now
cards.Notes: 利 lì profit, benefit (利用, 便利店) + 息 xī rest, breath (休息); also 'grow, breed' = profit that money breeds, so interest. 利率 = interest rate (率 as in 效率).

cards.Example: 他把钱都拿去投资了。 tā bǎ qián dōu ná qù tóuzī le: He put all his money into investments
cards.Notes: 投 tóu throw, put in, 扌 hand (投篮, 投票) + 资 zī capital, 贝 money (工资, 资金) = throw money in, so invest / investment. Shares 资 with 工资.

cards.Example: 你买保险了吗? nǐ mǎi bǎoxiǎn le ma: Do you have insurance?
cards.Notes: 保 bǎo protect, keep (保护, 保证) + 险 xiǎn danger, risk (危险) = protect against danger, so insurance. 买保险 = take out insurance. 保险 also means 'safe, a sure bet'.

cards.Example: 这个价格含税吗? zhège jiàgé hán shuì ma: Does this price include tax?
cards.Notes: 税 shuì tax: 禾 grain radical (种, 秋) because taxes were once paid in grain; 兑 gives the sound (cf. 说). 交税 = pay tax; 报税 = file taxes; 退税 = tax refund.

cards.English: to manage one's money / personal finance
cards.Example: 年轻人也该学学理财。 niánqīngrén yě gāi xuéxue lǐcái: Young people should learn to manage money too
cards.Notes: 理 lǐ manage, put in order (管理, 整理) + 财 cái wealth, 贝 money (发财, 财富) = manage wealth, so personal finance. 理财产品 = bank investment products.

cards.Example: 我直接转账给你吧。 wǒ zhíjiē zhuǎnzhàng gěi nǐ ba: I'll just transfer it to you
cards.Notes: 转 zhuǎn turn, transfer (转身, 转告) + 账 zhàng account, 贝 money (账单, 结账) = turn money over to another account, so transfer. 微信转账 = WeChat transfer.

cards.English: Interest on savings is so low now, it's not worth it.
cards.Hanzi: 现在存款利息太低了，不划算。
cards.Pinyin: xiànzài cúnkuǎn lìxī tài dī le, bú huàsuàn.

cards.English: Buying a flat means taking out a loan, and that's real pressure.
cards.Hanzi: 买房得贷款，压力确实很大。
cards.Pinyin: mǎi fáng děi dàikuǎn, yālì quèshí hěn dà.
cards.Notes: 贷款 (L20) + 压力 (L4) + 确实 (L1). 贷款 works as a verb too.

cards.English: My mum suspects all those online investments are scams.
cards.Hanzi: 我妈怀疑网上那些投资都是骗人的。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ mā huáiyí wǎngshang nàxiē tóuzī dōu shì piàn rén de.
cards.Notes: 投资 (L20) + 怀疑 (L17). 骗人的 = a con.

cards.English: I've just transferred it to you, can you check it came through?
cards.Hanzi: 我刚转账给你了，你确认一下。
cards.Pinyin: wǒ gāng zhuǎnzhàng gěi nǐ le, nǐ quèrèn yíxià.
cards.Notes: 转账 (L20) + 确认 (L5). 转账给 someone = send money to them.

cards.English: To get a loan at the bank, you need to bring a lot of documents.
cards.Hanzi: 去银行办理贷款，要带很多材料。
cards.Pinyin: qù yínháng bànlǐ dàikuǎn, yào dài hěn duō cáiliào.

cards.English: After tax and insurance, there's not much salary left.
cards.Hanzi: 扣完税和保险，工资就没剩多少了。
cards.Pinyin: kòu wán shuì hé bǎoxiǎn, gōngzī jiù méi shèng duōshao le.
cards.Notes: 税 (L20) + 保险 (L20). 扣 = deduct.

cards.English: He's so good with money, no wonder he has so much saved.
cards.Hanzi: 他太会理财了，难怪存款那么多。
cards.Pinyin: tā tài huì lǐcái le, nánguài cúnkuǎn nàme duō.

cards.English: I envy people who know how to invest and manage their money.
cards.Hanzi: 我羡慕那些会投资理财的人。
